beats.care: That 'style' plate with hidden digits can cost you your bike and a criminal case. Use a proper high-security registration plate.
beats.what: Hyderabad Traffic Police filed 100 criminal cases and seized 88 two-wheelers and 12 cars with forged or altered number plates over eight months.
beats.why: Police say fake plates let riders dodge traffic enforcement and hide vehicle identity, which can also shield other crimes.

cards.body: Joint Commissioner (Traffic) D Joel Davis said special drives will continue. Police asked owners to follow plate rules, including high-security registration plates, and asked the public to report suspected fake plates.
Traffic cameras send challans to whoever owns the plate number. A fake plate can send your fines to an innocent person, and make a vehicle used in a crime hard to trace.
cards.title: why is it a big deal?

cards.q: Seen bikes with hidden plate digits?

opts: They hide who the vehicle belongs to
cards.q: Why do police treat fake plates as serious?
cards.why: A number plate is a vehicle's identity, so faking it defeats cameras and investigations.

hook: Bent the digits on your bike plate? *100 vehicles* got seized.

learn.t: Faking or altering a number plate is a criminal case, not just a challan, because it hides who is driving.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Hyderabad Traffic Police seize 100 vehicles over fake number plates

tldr: Hyderabad Traffic Police have booked 100 criminal cases and seized 100 vehicles with fake or tampered number plates in eight months, and say drives will continue.
